start: Signed in, online, every change already copied

user_sees: 'Keep your workouts on MettleUp'
'Signed in as <email>'
'Your workouts are saved to your MettleUp account automatically. Last saved: <date>, <time>.'
'Only you can see what is saved. Your gym cannot. Progress photos stay on this phone.'
must_not: A time in another time zone or without the year
A waiting count when nothing waits

start: Signed in; the server said the sign-in is no longer valid

user_sees: 'Sign in again to keep saving your workouts on MettleUp.'
Button 'Continue with Google'
must_not: 'Last saved' shown as if all is fine

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' and sign in again
user_sees: The line goes back to 'Last saved: ...' after the next copy
must_not: The waiting changes lost

start: Signed in; the member's space on MettleUp is full

user_sees: 'Your space on MettleUp is full, so new workouts stay on this phone only. Please tell us in Settings → "Help and feedback".'
must_not: New workouts claimed as saved

start: Not signed in, or a build without the member account

user_sees: No status line; the card body and 'Continue with Google' (or no card at all on a build without the account)
must_not: 'Your workouts will be saved on MettleUp in a moment.' for a phone that is not signed in

start: Just signed in; then offline; then online again

steps.action: Open the card before the first copy
user_sees: 'Your workouts will be saved on MettleUp in a moment.'
must_not: 'Last saved' before anything was saved

steps.action: Go offline, save one change, reopen Settings
user_sees: '1 change is waiting for the internet. They are saved by themselves when you are online.'
must_not: Plural words for one change

steps.action: Come back online, wait, reopen Settings
user_sees: 'Last saved: <now>'
must_not: The waiting line stuck after the copy went through

start: Signed in and online; one item was refused by the server (too big or damaged) and stays in the queue

user_sees: Today: '1 change is waiting for the internet. They are saved by themselves when you are online.'
must_not: A line blaming the internet while the phone is online and the server refused the item
The 'Last saved' time hidden for good by one stuck item

start: Signed in member at a gym

user_sees: 'Only you can see what is saved. Your gym cannot. Progress photos stay on this phone.'

must_not: The email or the saved copy visible to the gym panel
